description: A recording's numbers, read by the page alone. kind: a bed (a loop under the physics), a shot (played once) or the probe (decoded to choose the format). voice: which of the page's voices plays it (none where empty). gain: dB over that voice's own level. The rest is written by go run ./tools/sounds -encode: the SHA-256 of the master it was built from, its seconds and channels, the WebM's integrated loudness (LUFS) and true peak (dBTP), and each file's bytes.
